facts: It costs approximately $10,000 to train a federally certified search and rescue dog.
Did you hear that? Sound frequency is measured in Hertz (Hz). The higher the Hertz, the higher-pitched the sound. Dogs hear best at 8,000 Hz, while humans hear best at around 2,000 Hz.
Only dogs and humans have prostates.
The oldest dog on record was a Australian Cattle Dog named Bluey, who lived to be 29 years and 5 months old.
A dog's nose is made up of about 220 million scent receptors, while a human's nose has about 5 million.
